The redesign widens the allocation across ['A_CANCELLED', 'O_CANCELLED', 'W_Completeren aanvraag'] so one person can carry the whole stretch — 64 resources currently serve it. No Case Assignment candidate claims these activities, so this is a stretch CA's waiting-based selection does not reach.
